audience: warehouse and dispatch teams that ship orders through GoSweetSpot

useCases.title: Compare carriers, services and rates before booking
useCases.text: List the carriers, services and stock sizes for the site. Then get the rates for one destination and its packages. No shipment is created.

useCases.title: Validate a delivery address
useCases.text: Check the state, suburb, postcode and country of one address. For New Zealand, the result also flags rural, Saturday and residential delivery, and lists the services that reach it.

useCases.title: Find pending orders and their packing slips
useCases.text: List the orders published to the queue but not yet processed. Filter the customer orders by packing slip number or created date to find one order.

useCases.title: Follow an order or consignment to delivery
useCases.text: Read the status of an order by its packing slip number, with its ticket number and tracking URL. Read the pickup and delivery times of consignment numbers.

useCases.title: Save new orders or remove unprocessed consignments
useCases.text: Create or update up to 100 orders in one batch. Delete up to 50 consignments that are not yet picked up, and read the outcome of each one. No carrier is booked.
